messages.subject: Bayesian Workshops in North America??
parts:
Hello All,

Wondering if anyone is aware of or planning a Bayesian Modelling workshop in North America this year?  I have seen a couple slated for locations in Europe, hoping for something closer to home.  I have a Ph.D. and postdoc I would like to send to one.

thank you
Christian

there are vague talks about doing one in the U.S. this year. If and once this materializes, we will advertise on this list and elsewhere.

Best regards  ---- Marc

*** Three hierarchical modeling email lists ***
(1) unmarked (this list): for questions specific to the R package unmarked
(2) SCR: for design and Bayesian or non-bayesian analysis of spatial capture-recapture
(3) HMecology: for everything else, especially material covered in the books by Royle & Dorazio (2008), Kéry & Schaub (2012), Kéry & Royle (2016, 2021) and Schaub & Kéry (2022)
